title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, the probability of the binary outcome is modeled using the logistic function, which is also known as the sigmoid function.

title: Logistic Function Properties
text: The logistic function, denoted as sigma, is defined as $$sigma(x)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-x\right)}}$$. It maps any real-valued number into the $$(0,1)$$ interval.

title: Symmetry of the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function is symmetric around the point $$x=0$$. This means that $$sigma(x)=1-sigma(-x)$$.
